crossRefs.note: Yahweh commanded us to do all these statutes, to fear Yahweh our God, for our good always, that he might preserve us…
If you are wise, you are wise for yourself. If you mock, you alone will bear it.
I will give them one heart and one way, that they may fear me forever, for their good, and the good of their children…
But he who looks into the perfect law of freedom and continues, not being a hearer who forgets, but a doer of the work…

translations.web: to keep Yahweh’s commandments and statutes, which I command you today for your good?
translations.bsb: and to keep the commandments and statutes of the LORD that I am giving you this day for your own good?
translations.kjv: To keep the commandments of the LORD, and his statutes, which I command thee this day for thy good?
translations.asv: to keep the commandments of Jehovah, and his statutes, which I command thee this day for thy good?
